notes: The site's bot wall blocks plain fetches but a real browser session loads it; the PDF itself downloads directly. Pizza styles by oven: Classic American (12-13 in, 535F), Classic Italian (535F/575F), Napoletana (900F wood-fired, 12 in; Margherita limited to 73/day), California (900F), Detroit (serves 2-4, 25 min), Coal Fired (1000F, 19-20 in, serves 2-4), Grandma (limit 20/day), Sicilian (serves 2-6), Romana (long thin, serves 2-4), NY High Five (18-19 in thin 5-grain), New York 20 in, St. Louis, Gluten-Free (11 in cauliflower or 7 in square, 500F), plant-based. Gluten-free crust +6.25 on classic pizzas. Menu notes: only complete parties seated; max 3 credit cards per transaction; fountain soda includes one refill (extra 1.25); water by request.
price_level_basis: median $34.00 of 37 prices in sections ['Classic American Pizza', 'Classic Italian Pizza', 'Napoletana Pizza', 'California Pizza', 'Housemade Pasta']; rule L1<10, L2<18, L3<30, L4>=30
